home.title: Aveline staff
home.lead: Tools for Aveline’s own team. Each says if it is not for your role.

list.title: Find a customer
list.searchLabel: Organization’s name, or part of it

open.title: Open an account
open.lead: This opens the customer’s organization and emails them an invitation to own it. You don’t become a member, and they choose their own password.
open.name: Organization’s name
open.invited: {{name}} is open, and they’ve been emailed an invitation.
open.existing: This address is already on {{name}}, as a member or invited, so nothing new was opened and no email went out. Check it’s the customer’s own before setting up an event in it.
open.several: This address is on several organizations. Choose the customer’s own.
open.severalNone: This address is on more than one organization, and they can’t be listed here, as they may be invitations still waiting. Ask the customer which they mean, or to accept first.

newEvent.lead: The event goes in {{name}}, the customer’s organization. You run it from your staff role.

refusal.needsChoice: Choose which organization this is for.
refusal.forbidden: This page is for Aveline’s staff. Your events stay open to you from your home page.
refusal.rateLimited: Too many requests just now. Please wait a moment and try again.
refusal.gone: That organization is no longer theirs, or no longer there. Search for it again.
refusal.noAnswer: We didn’t get an answer. Please try again.
